problemSection.headline: Promoting indie music is a minefield

cards.title: Fake playlists burn artists
cards.description: Bot-filled playlists inflate your stream count and can get your music flagged by Spotify. Most "promotion" services can't tell you where your streams actually came from.

cards.title: DIY pitching doesn't scale
cards.description: Finding curators, checking their playlists are real, writing pitches, following up — doing that one playlist at a time is a full-time job on top of making music.

cards.title: No data, no learning
cards.description: If you can't see which playlists added you, how long you stayed, and what it did for your listeners, you can't tell what worked — or what to do differently on the next release.

valueProposition.headline: Verified curators. Matched by your sound. Measured in the open.
valueProposition.body:
Playlist DNA analyzes your track's audio profile and matches it to curators whose playlists genuinely fit — by genre, mood, and sound, not spray-and-pray blasts.

Every curator in the network is vetted and re-verified, and every placement shows up in your campaign dashboard. You always know where your music is, and what it's doing there.

items.question: Is Playlist Push legit?
items.answer: Yes. Playlist Push has been operating since 2017 and works only with verified playlist curators — real people with real audiences. Curators are reviewed before joining the network and monitored continuously. No bots, no fake streams, no guaranteed-placement schemes.

items.question: Do you guarantee streams or placements?
items.answer: No — and you should be suspicious of anyone who does. Curators make their own editorial decisions. What we guarantee is that your track reaches verified curators matched to your sound, and that you can see every result in your dashboard.

items.question: What does a campaign cost?
items.answer: Campaigns start at $280 and scale with your budget and goals. You pay per campaign — there's no subscription and no recurring fee.

items.question: How does Playlist DNA matching work?
items.answer: Playlist DNA analyzes the audio characteristics of your track — genre, mood, energy, sound — and matches it against curator playlist profiles, so your music lands with curators who actually feature your kind of music.

items.question: I'm an independent artist without a label. Is this for me?
items.answer: That's exactly who Playlist Push is built for. More than 50,000+ artists have run campaigns — you don't need a label, a distributor deal, or an existing following to start.

items.question: How do I see my results?
items.answer: Your campaign dashboard shows every curator review, playlist placement, and the follower and stream activity around your campaign — live, from start to finish.
